spec2def(ieframe.dll ieframe.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

list(APPEND ieframe_rc_deps
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ieframe.rgs
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/ietoolbar.bmp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/pages.ico)

add_idl_reg_objects(ieframe registry ieframe_v1.idl)
add_idl_reg_objects(ieframe regtypelib ieframe_v1.idl)
 # CORE-5743: No CONST_VTABLE

# ieframe.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ieframe-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(ieframe_shims OBJECT classinfo.c client.c dochost.c events.c frame.c ie.c ieframe_main.c iehtmlwnd.c iexplore.c inetfolder.c intshcut.c navigate.c oleobject.c persist.c shellbrowser.c shelluihelper.c urlhist.c view.c webbrowser.c)
target_link_libraries(ieframe_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload oldnames liburlmon libshell32 libcomctl32 libshlwapi liboleaut32 libole32 libuser32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(ieframe_shims)
add_dependencies(ieframe_shims stdole2)
set(IEFRAME_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/ieframe/ieframe_v1_r.o
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/ieframe/ieframe_v1_t.o)
add_cargo_module(ieframe ieframe-cargo ieframe.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ieframe_shims psdk ieframe_r ieframe_t ${IEFRAME_REUSED} uuid_sources)
